fullPassage: Traditionally, most ecologists assumed that community stability ― the ability of a community to withstand environmental disturbances ― is a consequence of community complexity. That is, a community with considerable species richness may function better and be more stable than a community with less species richness. According to this view, the greater the species richness is, the less critically important any single species should be. With many possible interactions within the community, it is unlikely that any single disturbance could affect enough components of the system to make a significant difference in its functioning. Evidence for this hypothesis includes the fact that destructive outbreaks of pests are more common in cultivated fields, which are low-diversity communities, than in natural communities with greater species richness.

✅ ② consequence of community complexity: 원문 일치, 복잡성 → 안정성
❌ ③ product of environmental pressure: 환경 압력의 산물, 원문과 무관
❌ ④ sign of ecological imbalance: 생태 불균형의 징표, 원문과 반대
det.tip: community stability is a consequence of community complexity = 핵심 주장

questions.passage: Traditionally, most ecologists assumed that community stability ― the ability of a community to withstand environmental disturbances ― is a consequence of community complexity. That is, a community with considerable species richness may function better and be more stable than a community with less species richness. According to this view, the greater the species richness is, the less critically important any single species should be. With many possible interactions within the community, it is unlikely that any single disturbance could affect enough components of the system to make a significant difference in its functioning. Evidence for this hypothesis includes the fact that destructive outbreaks of pests are more common in cultivated fields, which are __________, than in natural communities with greater species richness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: low-diversity communities(저다양성 군집) — 경작지는 종 다양성이 낮은 군집이므로 해충 발생이 더 흔하다는 증거
det.analysis:
❌ ① high-diversity ecosystems: 고다양성, 의미 역전
❌ ② stable natural habitats: 안정적 자연 서식지, 경작지와 반대
❌ ③ complex food webs: 복잡한 먹이망, 원문은 다양성 기준
✅ ④ low-diversity communities: 원문 일치, 경작지 = 저다양성 군집
det.tip: cultivated fields = low-diversity communities → 해충 발생 多
